limitations_and_boundaries: Electrophysiological properties (including LTP) were not changed at 5 days after injection of C1q antibodies.
A single injection of anti-C1q did not improve LTP; longer treatment may be needed.
Multiple other changes induced by tauopathy in the PSD might not be fixed by neutralization of C1q.

research_questions.statement: What are the molecular changes at hippocampal synapses in tauopathy and can C1q antibodies rescue synapse loss?

provenance.text_excerpt: Thus, we hypothesized that knockdown of the GTPase regulators caused loss of spines via dysregulation of the postsynaptic actin network and investigated whether pharmacological stabilization of filamentous actin (F-actin) would stabilize spines.

claims.statement: Loss of postsynaptic GTPase-regulatory proteins leads to loss of dendritic spines via dysregulation of actin cytoskeleton.

experiments_or_tasks: siRNA-mediated knockdown of Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, Trio in cultured hippocampal neurons and measurement of spine density.

methods.name: siRNA knockdown in cultured hippocampal neurons
methods.protocol_description: Hippocampal neurons were incubated with individual siRNAs against Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, or Trio for 5 days in vitro (DIV14+5), then spine density was measured.

study_units.name: siRNA knockdown of GTPase regulators and spine density

results.metric_name: Spine density change after siRNA knockdown

provenance.text_excerpt: Neurons incubated with individual siRNAs against Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, or Trio showed 30%–50% decreased spine density, while siRNA against Iqsec3, which was not changed in Tau-P301S PSDs, had no effect on spine density (Figure 3B).

results.value_raw_text: Neurons treated with siRNAs against Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, or Trio showed 30%–50% decreased spine density; siRNA against Iqsec3 had no effect.

results.metric_name: Spine density rescue by F-actin stabilization

provenance.text_excerpt: Phallacidin had no effect on spines in control cultures but restored spine density in neurons treated with siRNAs targeting Iqsec2, Kalirin, Trio, or Iqgap1 and Iqgap2, or even led to spine density greater than control neurons (Figure 3C).

results.value_raw_text: Phallacidin restored spine density in neurons treated with siRNAs targeting Iqsec2, Kalirin, Trio, or Iqgap1 and Iqgap2, or led to spine density greater than control neurons.

provenance.text_excerpt: we observed a significant reduction in a set of proteins that regulate small GTPase signaling in Tau-P301S PSDs ... Particularly striking was that the most highly increased proteins in Tau-P301S PSD fractions are subunits of C1q

claims.statement: Pathological Tau accumulation alters protein composition of PSD in Tau-P301S mice, with reduction in GTPase-regulatory proteins and increase in C1q.

datasets.description: Quantitative MS data of PSD proteome for nonTg and Tau-P301S mice, including statistics of differentially expressed proteins and disease associations (Table S1).
datasets.name: PSD proteome of Tau-P301S vs nonTg mice

experiments_or_tasks: Quantitative mass spectrometry of postsynaptic density (PSD) fractions from 9-month-old Tau-P301S and nonTg mouse hippocampi.

methods.name: Mass spectrometry analysis of PSD
methods.protocol_description: PSD fractions were prepared from hippocampal tissue of 9-month-old Tau-P301S and nonTg mice and analyzed by quantitative mass spectrometry.

study_units.name: Proteomic analysis of PSD in Tau-P301S mice

provenance.text_excerpt: By western blotting of a different cohort of mice, we confirmed that C1q was greatly increased (with high inter-animal variability) in PSDs of 9-month-old Tau-P301S hippocampi and barely detectable in the nonTg PSD (Figure 4A).

results.value_raw_text: C1q was greatly increased in PSDs of 9-month-old Tau-P301S hippocampi and barely detectable in nonTg PSD.

provenance.text_excerpt: we observed a significant reduction in a set of proteins that regulate small GTPase signaling in Tau-P301S PSDs (Figures 2A and 2C). Conversely, proteins that showed enrichment in Tau-P301S PSDs are mainly involved in translation and biosynthetic processes. ... Particularly striking was that the most highly increased proteins in Tau-P301S PSD fractions are subunits of C1q (Figure 2A; see below).

results.value_raw_text: Significant reduction in proteins regulating small GTPase signaling (Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, Trio) and enrichment of C1q subunits in Tau-P301S PSDs.

results.metric_name: Protein abundance change in PSD (immunoblot validation)

provenance.text_excerpt: Corroborating the MS analysis, we confirmed by immunoblotting the significant decrease of PSD levels of Iqgap2, Iqsec2, and Kalirin in 9-month-old Tau-P301S hippocampi (Figure 3A). ... Trio ... was also significantly reduced by ~30% in Tau-P301S-PSD fractions by immunoblot analysis of an independent cohort (Figures 2A and 3A).

results.value_raw_text: Significant decrease of PSD levels of Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, and Trio in 9-month-old Tau-P301S hippocampi confirmed by immunoblotting.

provenance.text_excerpt: our results demonstrate that C1q antibodies can reduce synapse removal by microglia and lead to a recovery of synapse density in cultures and in vivo.

claims.statement: C1q-blocking antibody prevents microglial synapse removal and rescues synapse density in Tau-P301S mice.

experiments_or_tasks: Stereotaxic injection of C1q-blocking or isotype control antibodies into right dorsal hippocampus of 9-month-old Tau-P301S mice, analysis 5 days later.

methods.name: Stereotaxic antibody injection
methods.protocol_description: C1q-blocking or isotype control antibodies were injected into the right dorsal hippocampus of 9-month-old Tau-P301S mice. Brains were analyzed 5 days post-injection.

study_units.name: C1q-blocking antibody injection in Tau-P301S mice

provenance.text_excerpt: we measured a slight but significant increase in PSD-95 and Synapsin puncta density in CA1 at 5 days after injection of C1q blocking antibody, relative to control IgG (Figure 8D).

results.value_raw_text: Significant increase in PSD-95 and Synapsin puncta density in CA1 at 5 days after injection of C1q blocking antibody, relative to control IgG.

provenance.text_excerpt: In the ipsilateral CA1 region, the C1q-blocking antibody resulted in ~50% reduction in PSD-95 or Synapsin puncta within microglial lysosomes, as compared to control IgG (Figure 8C)

results.value_raw_text: C1q-blocking antibody resulted in ~50% reduction in PSD-95 or Synapsin puncta within microglial lysosomes in ipsilateral CA1 region, compared to control IgG.
